svg.title: A reflecting telescope
svg.desc: Parallel rays from a distant object strike a large concave mirror, the objective, which reflects them toward its focal point. A small flat mirror at 45° intercepts them and sends them down through an eyepiece lens, which makes them parallel again for the eye. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Follow light through a reflecting telescope
Tracers follow the original spherical-mirror ray calculation at equal distance per display time. They
mark the path; the telescope receives continuous light.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
